gloss: here and there; everywhere; all around

definitions.gloss: here and there; everywhere; all around; various places
definitions.explanation: Many different places; in all directions. Indicates searching, visiting, or existing in multiple locations.

examples.japanese: {方々|ほうぼう}⟦{探|さが}したが→探す：00493_sagasu⟧、⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I searched everywhere but couldn't find it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{方々|ほうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He has debts all over the place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{方々|ほうぼう}⟦{飛|と}び{回|まわ}っている→飛び回る：04610_tobimawaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm running around to various places for work.

examples.japanese: {方々|ほうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}して→電話する：01471_denwa⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: I called various places to confirm.
He is well-known in various places.

notes:
READING: This word has two readings with different meanings:
- ほうぼう - here and there, everywhere
- かたがた - people (polite plural)

USAGE: Often used with verbs of motion or searching to indicate visiting or covering many locations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {方々|ほうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around to various places)
- {方々|ほうぼう}⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to search everywhere)
- {方々|ほうぼう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (in various places, to various places)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧ (here and there - more casual)
- ⟦{所々|ところどころ}→所々：04009_tokorodokoro⟧ (here and there - sporadic)
- ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧ (various regions - more formal)
